MultiLevelContextCache._lock.evidence: All callers (get, set, clear, _find_similar_entry_faiss, _find_similar_entry_hnsw) are async def. Lock guards stats dict and cache list mutations. No await inside lock blocks.

UniversalMemoryCoordinator.self.lock.evidence: Guards _allocated and _zone_usage written only from sync context (allocate/free/touch). No async methods touch this lock.

_ANNIndex._lock.evidence: Guards LanceDB table.search() and table.add() in sync context. All callers (ann_search, upsert, close) are sync def from embedding_pipeline. No async def methods in class.

module._ann_index_lock.evidence: Guards module-level _ann_index singleton via double-checked locking. get_ann_index() is sync def. No async callers.
